mainEntity.name: What is an APAC crypto PR agency and do I need one?

acceptedAnswer.text: An APAC crypto PR agency runs media placement and narrative strategy specifically for Korea, Japan, Vietnam, China, India and MENA, where the editors, KOLs and community gatekeepers operate in their own languages and news cycles. You need one if your project is listing on a Korean or Japanese exchange, raising from APAC funds, or entering the Middle East RWA market, and you want real coverage rather than a translated wire blast. The fractional model through Shilika Jain covers all six markets for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does APAC crypto PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator covering APAC runs $5K–$12K/month for sustained retainer work. A defined launch sprint targeting one or two markets costs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. A global agency with a localisation add-on typically runs $20K–$50K/month once the regional surcharge is included. KOL amplification in Korea or Japan sits in the nano tier ($200–$1.5K per creator) to mid tier ($10K–$30K) depending on the influencer's reach and the campaign scope.

mainEntity.name: Which APAC outlets can you actually place my project in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Korea: BloomingBit, TokenPost, Cobak, Naver Blog crypto communities. Japan: CoinPost, CryptoTimes JP, ZaikoCast podcast circuit. Vietnam: CoinCu, CryptoVN. China: ChainCatcher, Jinse, PANews. India: Inc42, CoinCrunch, BW Businessworld crypto desk. MENA: Arab Times crypto desk, regional English-language business press for RWA and DeFi angles. Tier-1 global outlets (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt) run in parallel where the story warrants it. Coverage depends on a real news hook, not a wire service subscription.

mainEntity.name: What is the process and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks go to a market audit and regional narrative: identifying the one thesis that travels across APAC markets and mapping the specific angle for each country desk. Weeks three and four are embargo prep and outreach, with native-language pitches timed to each market's press window. For a coordinated six-market launch, expect four to six weeks from brief to coverage. For a single-market sprint, two to three weeks is realistic.

Send a short project brief through the intent form, including which APAC markets matter most and what the news hook is. You will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current regional press footprint and where the leverage is. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call and we will map the regional strategy live. No agency intro deck, no multi-person onboarding call.
